meta.name: Lupeo
meta.description: LUPEO is based on true events of January 12, 2010, the memorial of the tragic earthquake in Haiti. After receiving the tragic news of the 7.0 earthquakes, the Lenor's attempt, to connect with their loved ones in Port-au-Prince, has taken more than a toll on them. With prayers, patience and the help a survived family member, they were able to locate some of the missing ones. The condition in which they were found will need more then just love and money to overcome this experience.
